summary: A transported compact vector potential analytically localizes the affine-amplified shear correction, cancels its transport defect, and yields a complete Euler residual with arbitrary-order scale-explicit derivative bounds on compact time intervals. Exact polynomial verification remains unresolved because the executed verifier changed its profile state, so confidence is partial-proof.

value_assessment.novelty: The supplied prior slice gave a general residual but no all-order scale bounds or completed independent verification. This attempt reproduces that identity, chooses affine-flow-transported cutoffs so its defect vanishes, expands the force into fixed scaled profiles, and derives every mixed-derivative scale exponent.
value_assessment.evidence: Two independent componentwise analytic derivations and an arbitrary-order chain-rule and Bell-polynomial estimate are recorded with the attempt. The failed polynomial run is retained only as a reproducible verifier obstruction.
value_assessment.falsifier: A correct immutable exact-rational expansion with a nonzero raw-versus-closed residual coefficient, or a counterexample to the stated mixed-derivative chain rule, would overturn the scoped claim.

claims.statement: For the explicitly defined affine strain and transported compact vector potential on Euclidean three-space, the curl correction is divergence-free, agrees with the shear on its moving core, has zero transport defect, and has the three displayed residual components.
claims.evidence_summary: A perturbation expansion and a separate raw-coordinate expansion agree algebraically; scaled differentiation gives the closed profiles.
claims.verification_method: Audit both derivations and rerun the coefficient comparison using immutable exact-rational polynomials.

claims.statement: On each compact time interval, every mixed spatial and time derivative of the displayed residual obeys the recorded scale-explicit estimate with Bell-polynomial time constants.
claims.evidence_summary: Spatial chain rules expose all localization powers and Faà di Bruno in accumulated strain gives arbitrary time order.
claims.verification_method: Verify time orders one and two directly, then audit the Bell-polynomial induction.

limitations: The exact symbolic verification required by the parent did not complete successfully.
The affine background remains nondecaying and infinite-energy; only the correction and residual are compactly supported.
Viscosity would add an unexpanded Laplacian correction.
No finite-time breakdown or Navier--Stokes regularity conclusion is established.
failed_approaches: The stateful terminating-decimal polynomial verifier produced a nonzero transport defect and raw-component mismatch after diagnostics showed a profile coefficient changing from one to two. Its output cannot certify or falsify the analytic formula.
next_actions: Implement an immutable exact-rational comparison and require zero transport defect before residual comparison.
Directly audit the arbitrary-time derivative formula at orders one and two.
